human_feedback_kind: Owner clarified that end users must understand project-specific technical, architectural and product usefulness; prior explanation was unclear. No per-case acceptance scores inferred.
criteria: Confirmed goal and project constraint are distinguished from unknowns.
Source-supported capability explains mechanism and expected project benefit; unmeasured benefit is a hypothesis.
Conditional comparison explains preference and when it reverses.
Architecture placement, integration cost and set member roles are explained or explicitly unknown.
A concrete next check resolves a decision-changing uncertainty.
RU/EN preserves facts, uncertainty, roles and proposed status; plain language is persona-appropriate.
nonblocking_findings: H15 remains long/dense for a low-context operator; foreground device/offline question and show the relevant conditional branch.
limits: Model-authored fresh-context compositions after explicit instruction reads plus static review; not installed-plugin routing or activation.
Comparison is not blinded and not a controlled causal attribution to prompt alone.
All four examples are same-role alternatives; complementary sets lack a positive worked-case evaluation.
Project benefits, compatibility and time/cost/performance improvements are not measured.
Old retrieval judgments and numerical advisory grades remain frozen; failed CP04 gates are not waived.
